At 16¢, the 40T's 650 W runs about $75 a month, and the unit's $799. You're drawing for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, and stacking sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

First miner is the best reason to get one. You're running a real piece of the network at your desk — you see it, hear it, learn how pools and wallets actually work, and it draws for a block every ten minutes for years.

At $799, 650 W, about $75/month in power at your rate. Where would it sit — office or garage?
